text: Kaa ko hommbo fewnirta on ka niɓe njorndi e ka niɓe maayo ɗin maandeeji ɗi O waɗani on e koode, e ko hommbo nulata keni ɗin fii yo ɗi wewlinir ɓadagol saaƴugol toɓo ngo O Yurminirta ngon jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen? Enee, ko reweteeɗo goo woni waɗude ɗum wonndude e Alla?! Alla Senike, O laaɓii gaayi e ko ɓe sirkanta Mo kon immorde e tageefooji Makko ɗin.
